== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[K'lor'slug (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. The first available Set 0 slip includes a separate protection against Bad Feeling Have I. The December 2015 ledger describes the change to the loss-before-damage rule. The date of removal of the Bad Feeling Have I clause is unconfirmed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
